# Agent Maturity Compass (AMC)

> See what your AI agent really does. AMC watches Claude Code, Codex or your own agent at work on your machine, keeps a signed record of what it did, and scores it from that record. Free and open source (MIT); no AMC account.

## Install (current source build, macOS and Linux)
curl -fsSL https://agentmaturity.co/install-source.sh | sh
Pin a tag or commit: curl -fsSL https://agentmaturity.co/install-source.sh | sh -s -- --ref <tag or full commit id>

Needs git and Node.js (>=20, tested on 22 and 24) with Corepack (Node.js 25 and later do not include Corepack). The script builds AMC from GitHub into ~/.amc-source and puts amc on the PATH. Three limits: the address serves the script only after the website is published (until then: git clone the repository, then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build && npm link); install.sh below installs the older published 1.1.1; the Windows twin (irm https://agentmaturity.co/install-source.ps1 | iex) has not been tested on Windows. The source build is unreleased and reports version 1.2.0.

Published 1.1.1 release (older; no menu, no vendor sign-in, Industry Packs still behind the earlier licence gate):
macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://agentmaturity.co/install.sh | sh
Windows PowerShell: irm https://agentmaturity.co/install.ps1 | iex
The installers pin the GitHub release and verify SHA-256 before installing. npm also publishes 1.1.1; the Homebrew tap is not public yet. Publication evidence: https://agentmaturity.co/publication-status.json

Verify a real signed evidence bundle yourself: https://agentmaturity.co/verify.html

## First run
`amc` alone in a terminal shows one menu of what can work on this machine:
- Watch Claude Code as it works / Watch Codex as it works (shown once you are signed in with the vendor's own sign-in; `amc login status` shows it; AMC never sees the password, token or plan)
- Chat with a model (shown when a provider key such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set)
- Try a demo chat (no account or key needed; the built-in stand-in model gives canned replies)
- Open the console in my browser (the local Compass Console on 127.0.0.1)
- Just show my score (the full 244-question score; a new folder scores L0 because AMC has not seen the agent do anything yet)

Watching uses hooks. Observe mode records each tool call. Claude Code control mode can deny a tool call and needs Claude Code settings with no enabled plugin and no other hook that can change a tool call.

## Key Concepts
- L0-L5 maturity scale based on execution evidence; today L2 is the highest level, 240 of the 244 questions cannot rise above L1, and L3 to L5 are not evaluated
- Ed25519 signatures and hash-chained records (a signature shows who wrote a record and that it is unchanged, not that it is true)
- 244 default diagnostic questions across 5 trust dimensions, plus a 264-question lifecycle-expanded set
- 16 framework adapters (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.)
- Signed adapter capability receipts separate declared/effective events and controls, runtime and version record, hook mode, and lossiness; metadata-only adapters fail closed
- Domain Proof Lane with amcproof artifacts for source-to-rule correctness checks
- Evidence sources cap levels: self-reported records reach L1 at most; no trust weight is applied to a level
- 41 Industry Packs, free in the current source build with no licence, account or payment (the published 1.1.1 release still locks them): self-reported questionnaires whose content is experimental, AI-drafted until a named expert signs it; access never changes a result

## A4 Forge (preview)
- One agent from a brief to a recorded deployment in four stages: Aspire (conceptualization), Assemble (creation), Adapt (contextualization), Activate (commercialization); current source build only, a preview that is on by default (AMC_A4_PREVIEW=0 turns it off)
- Every A4 record is signed and self-reported; no A4 output says the agent is safe, correct or lawful, and approvals inside one workspace are not independent review
- [A4 Forge overview](https://agentmaturity.co/a4.html)
- [A4 Forge guide](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#A4_FORGE)
